subtitle.en: 108 names of Sri Ganesha, remover of obstacles

source.en: Traditional worship of Vighneshwara; recited before any new beginning, on Chaturthi tithi and during Ganesh Chaturthi
source.te: సంప్రదాయ విఘ్నేశ్వర పూజ; కొత్త పనులు మొదలుపెట్టే ముందు, చతుర్థి తిథులలో, గణేశ చతుర్థి రోజున పఠిస్తారు

benefit.en: Reciting the 108 names with devotion is believed to remove obstacles, grant success in all undertakings and bestow wisdom.
benefit.te: ఈ 108 నామాలను భక్తితో పఠించడం వల్ల విఘ్నాలు తొలగిపోతాయని, కార్యాలు సఫలమవుతాయని, జ్ఞానం లభిస్తుందని నమ్ముతారు.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the elephant-faced lord.
Salutations to the leader of Shiva's ganas.
Salutations to the king who rules over all obstacles.
Salutations to Vinayaka, the leader who removes all hindrances.
Salutations to the son of two mothers, Ganga and Parvati.
items.mean_te: గంగా పార్వతుల ఇద్దరు తల్లులకు కుమారుడైన వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one with an auspicious and pleasing face.
Salutations to the foremost one honored before all.
Salutations to the one with an ever-auspicious face.
Salutations to the one of perfect accomplishment.
Salutations to the lamp of divine wisdom.
items.mean_te: దివ్య జ్ఞానమనే దీపం వంటి వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the treasure-house of all happiness.
items.mean_te: అన్ని సుఖాలకు నిధి అయిన వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the overseer of all the gods.
Salutations to the slayer of the enemies of the gods.
Salutations to Mahaganapati, the great lord of the ganas.
Salutations to the one worthy of all honor.
Salutations to the one most worthy of honor among all.
Salutations to the beloved son of Mrida, Lord Shiva.
Salutations to the ancient one, existing from the very beginning.
Salutations to the primeval spirit dwelling in all beings.
Salutations to the one who nourishes and sustains all.
Salutations to the one who nourishes the world like the sun.
items.mean_te: సూర్యుని వలె లోకాన్ని పోషించే వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one who grants spiritual merit.
Salutations to the one ever counted as the first.
items.mean_te: ఎల్లప్పుడూ మొదటి వాడిగా లెక్కించబడే వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one worshipped before all others in every worship.
items.mean_te: అన్ని పూజలలోనూ మొదట పూజింపబడే వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one who moves ahead of everything.
Salutations to the source and embodiment of all mantras.
Salutations to the one radiant like molten gold.
items.mean_te: కరిగిన బంగారం వలె ప్రకాశించే వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one who is all that exists.
Salutations to the one worshipped by all the worlds.
Salutations to the one who is the doer of all deeds.
items.mean_te: సమస్త క్రియలకు కర్త అయిన వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one who steers everything.
Salutations to the giver of all accomplishments and powers.
Salutations to the one in whom all perfections are complete.
Salutations to the one saluted by every being.
Salutations to the great lord of time itself.
Salutations to the one of boundless strength.
Salutations to Heramba, the protector of the weak.
Salutations to the one with the long, hanging belly.
Salutations to the one with the short and mighty neck.
Salutations to the great-bellied one who holds the universe within.
Salutations to the one intoxicated with divine bliss.
items.mean_te: ఆనంద మదంతో ఉర్రూత లద్దే వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the great hero of unmatched valor.
Salutations to the wise counselor of the three worlds.
items.mean_te: మూడు లోకాలకు మంత్రి వంటి వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the bestower of all that is auspicious.
Salutations to the first preceptor of all knowledge.
Salutations to the one of profound wisdom.
Salutations to the one who is eternal delight.
Salutations to the one who delights in sweet modakas.
Salutations to the one of steadfast patience.
Salutations to the one of great intelligence.
Salutations to the one whom all hearts long for.
Salutations to the one fond of wood apple and jackfruit.
items.mean_te: కపిత్థ పనస పండ్లను ప్రేమించే వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one ever absorbed in the contemplation of Brahman.
Salutations to the one whose very form is Brahman.
Salutations to the knower of Brahman.
Salutations to the one worshipped by Brahma himself.
Salutations to the one who is ever victorious.
Salutations to the one beloved of Lord Vishnu.
Salutations to the very life of his devotees.
Salutations to the one who conquered even the god of love.
Salutations to the giver of wealth and prosperity.
Salutations to the elder brother of Guha, Lord Kartikeya.
items.mean_te: గుహుడైన కుమార స్వామి అన్నయ్య అయిన వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one served by all perfected sages.
Salutations to the one who sets obstacles before the wicked.
items.mean_te: దుర్మార్గుల కార్యాలలో విఘ్నం కలిగించే వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the remover of every obstacle.
Salutations to the one who leads the entire universe.
Salutations to the one who shines with majestic radiance.
Salutations to the self-ruling sovereign of all.
items.mean_te: తన సొంత ప్రభావంతో పాలించే వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the lord of all prosperity.
Salutations to the lord of speech and eloquence.
Salutations to the one endowed with divine glory.
Salutations to the one adorned with all divine ornaments.
Salutations to the one tenderly fond of those who surrender to him.
items.mean_te: శరణొచ్చిన వారిని వాత్సల్యంతో కాపాడే వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one most dear to Lord Shiva.
Salutations to the one who swiftly answers his devotees.
items.mean_te: భక్తుల అభ్యర్థనలను శీఘ్రంగా నెరవేర్చే వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the eternal one who never perishes.
Salutations to the beloved son of Shiva.
Salutations to the one exuberant with ever-growing strength.
items.mean_te: అపార బలంతో ఉర్రూత లద్దే వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the treasure-store of devotees.
Salutations to the one reached through deep devotion.
Salutations to the son of Bhavani, Mother Parvati.
Salutations to the infinitely great one.
Salutations to the one who grants auspiciousness always.
Salutations to Mahesha, the supreme lord.
Salutations to the one honored by the whole world.
Salutations to the one established in truth and dharma.
Salutations to the eternal support of everything.
Salutations to the embodiment of Truth.
Salutations to the one whose valor never fails.
Salutations to the one whose every limb is auspicious.
Salutations to the one with the pure shining tusks.
Salutations to the one who grants all that is good.
Salutations to the one whose whole form is auspicious.
Salutations to the destroyer of the five great sins.
items.mean_te: పంచ మహా పాతకాలను నాశనం చేసే వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the darling son of Parvati.
Salutations to the lord of the universe.
Salutations to the one whose feet the wise adore.
Salutations to the one who stands at the head of all heroes.
Salutations to the guru whom even Kumara, Kartikeya, worships.
Salutations to the slayer of the elephant demon Kunjarasura.
Salutations to the beloved lord of Vallabha, his consort.
Salutations to the one whose lotus hands bestow boons and fearlessness.
Salutations to the one who holds the pot of celestial nectar.
items.mean_te: దివ్యమైన సుధా కలశాన్ని ధరించిన వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one who wears the nectar-shedding moon.
items.mean_te: అమృతం కురిపించే చంద్రకళను ధరించిన వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the five-handed lord.
Salutations to the lord of the primordial nature.
items.mean_te: ప్రధాన ప్రకృతికి అధిపతి అయిన వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the most ancient of all.
Salutations to Varasiddhi Vinayaka, who grants boons and success.
